title: read --mentions should filter broadcasts or document that it does not
desc: DEFECT (verified, evidence: review #a5af03fe finding 4): bin/chatcode:626 passes every to:'*' message through the mentions filter, and say defaults to to:'*', so 'read --mentions <me>' returns nearly the whole channel — AGENT_PROMPT.md advertises it as 'what needs me'. Repro on current main: channel with 1 DM to carol + 1 broadcast; 'read --mentions bob' shows the broadcast. ACCEPTANCE: (1) pick a semantic — either to:'*' passes only when the text @-mentions the reader, or keep broadcast-inclusion — and state the decision + rationale in the PR description; (2) the chosen semantic is enforced by a one-command test (both directions: included and excluded cases); (3) AGENT_PROMPT.md/PROTOCOL.md wording updated if the implemented semantic differs from 'what needs me'; (4) no format changes (R10). NON-GOALS: rewriting fetch_messages.
